scripts.bootstrap: uv sync --directory server && pnpm --dir web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "uv run --directory server uvicorn nexus.app:create_app --factory --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765" "pnpm --dir web dev"
scripts.test: uv run --directory server pytest -q && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.lint: uv run --directory server ruff check . && pnpm --dir web lint
